modifications: Changed internal imports to package-relative imports.
Added optional explicit viewport parameter to hand.split/read_hand for automatic border detection and resolution normalization in the host wrapper.
Exposed the pattern runner-up margin, excluding red/ordinary-five variants; close matches require agreement from a second whole-tile comparison.
Closed reader template metadata file explicitly with UTF-8 encoding.
Added upstream meld.py with relative imports and clipped extension ROI bounds to avoid empty-image crashes.
Desktop scene reader uses component-based tile bodies, tint correction, and independent crop checks for the attached samples.

Widened meld.py across-region preset from (500,20,280,130) to (480,40,600,190) on the 2560x1440 base: two opponent calls extend further left than the original window covers. Host scene_recognize adds an original-resolution fallback that re-recognizes inverted opponent meld tiles when the upstream reader returns empty.
